subject.title: [Bug]: Codex app-server reply-session-init conflict leaves the session with no transcript mirror → tool-results silently return empty with no self-heal

question: Should maintainers require redacted after-fix live or Crabbox proof for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 before accepting the reply-session conflict recovery?
rationale: The candidate fix crosses session lifecycle, harness reset, and message/tool-result delivery boundaries; automation should not decide whether source tests alone are enough for that runtime recovery risk.

options.title: Require after-fix recovery proof
options.body: Ask for redacted patched-host logs, terminal output, or Crabbox proof showing the conflict recovers and tool-result delivery is non-empty before merge.

options.title: Accept source and focused tests
options.body: Merge based on code review and focused tests while explicitly owning the remaining live recovery uncertainty.

options.title: Request a different recovery boundary
options.body: Pause the linked PR and ask for a narrower or more generic session recovery design if the current teardown/reset path is not the desired owner boundary.

recommendation.title: Require after-fix recovery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted patched-host logs, terminal output, or Crabbox proof showing the conflict recovers and tool-result delivery is non-empty before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently refactored the guarded reply-session initialization boundary that the recovery decision extends.
